_readme: Configuration surfaces per asset: the controls that sit between an attacker and a successful exploit. This file describes the HOST - it does not know what the alert was, and it does not say whether any surface stopped it. Whether a control actually blocks the observed attack is the join the agent must make and show, exactly as section 5.1 requires for patch status: the CVE KB carries no `patched` boolean and this file carries no `prevents_exploitation` boolean.

surfaces.detail: ModSecurity CRS v3.3 in DetectionOnly mode - logs, does not block.
app_rw holds SELECT on all schemas including customers.
svc_report holds SELECT on all schemas.
No egress ACL on the database VLAN.
No WAF in front of the Tomcat connector.
app_rw holds SELECT on the reports schema.
svc_batch holds SELECT on all schemas.
Vendor WAF in DetectionOnly mode - logs, does not block.
fin_app holds SELECT on ledger and customers.
repl_user holds SELECT on all schemas.
No egress ACL on the database VLAN.
ModSecurity CRS v3.3 loaded, SecRuleEngine DetectionOnly. Rule 942100 alerts on SQLi but does NOT block; requests reach the application.

The portal connects as hr_portal_ro. Grants: SELECT on hr_public.* ONLY. hr_portal_ro holds NO privilege on hr_salary or on mysql.user. A UNION SELECT against either returns no rows to the caller regardless of syntax.
Egress ACL permits 443 to the payroll vendor only. No route exists for bulk egress to an arbitrary external host.
